title: Scheduled Queue
summary: Keeps scheduled sends visible: live countdowns, a last-chance window before the cancel cutoff, quiet-hour warnings and missed sends flagged.
description: Queue of scheduled sends that counts down each row, highlights the last-chance window before the real cancel cutoff, offers a one-tap move for sends landing in quiet hours where the audience lives, flags missed sends, and refuses past reschedule times.
catches: Time left before each send, and the last-chance window before cutoff
Sends locked in by the provider, with cancel disabled
Sends landing in quiet hours (default 22:00–07:00) in the audience's zone, with a move-to-9:00 fix
Missed or overdue sends, with Send now
limits: Quiet hours are judged in the zone you give each item; mixed audiences need splitting
Cutoff and lock state are as you configure them, not read from the provider
a11y: Last-chance and locked changes announced in a polite live region, not every tick
Reschedule input has an aria-label, autoFocus, aria-invalid for past times, and Escape to cancel
Errors use role=alert; locked rows disable Cancel/Reschedule with a lock icon and text
Row highlight animation is skipped under reduced motion
server: Enforce the cancel cutoff and reject past send times on the server; the provider's lock is the source of truth.
mistakes: scheduled send went out wrong time
